edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied black-and-white diamond pattern. Change ONLY the SINGLE black diamond at the EXACT CENTRE of the image to vivid yellow (#FFD400). The input is a 10000 by 10000 pixel square with 41 rows and 41 columns of black diamonds on white; the centre diamond is row 21, column 21, centred at (5000,5000). Keep its shape and size exactly unchanged. All other 1680 diamonds stay black and the background stays white. Preserve the original spacing, count, crisp geometry, square framing and resolution as closely as possible. No other yellow objects, outlines, labels, gradients, shading, text or borders. Return the edited image itself, not a mask.
mask_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert the supplied diamond-pattern edit into a registered black-and-white compositing mask. The input has exactly one YELLOW diamond at the exact centre. Output ONLY a solid WHITE silhouette of that yellow diamond, in exactly its input position and size. All other pixels must be solid BLACK, including the white background and every black diamond. Preserve the full square canvas, its framing and proportions exactly. Do not show the pattern, do not enlarge or move the selected diamond. White selects only the yellow diamond. No outlines, grey shading, labels, text, borders or other white shapes.
original: Procedural 10000 x 10000, 41 x 41 black diamonds, pitch 240 and radius 80. Centre at 5000,5000.
compositing: Original outside image-tool mask; only RGB pixels from the resized image-tool edit within the mask. Original and composite are lossless full-resolution PNGs; previews and native-resolution tiles feed the shared viewer.
